description: Universal HTML5 Viewer and Document Management Kit
releaseNotes:
### 3.4.12

#### DocuVieware

* Improves right-to-left pages: dialogs, comments and panels mirror, and each text keeps its own direction. (L#DV-798)
* Replaces the DocuVieware TWAIN connector with the Nutrient Scanning Connector, which scans on Windows and on Macs with Apple silicon. Each user approves the sites that may scan: the acquisition dialog, a scan or the new DocuViewareAPI.TwainGetSourcesAsync asks them, and TwainGetSources returns null until they have. After they refuse a site twice, the prompt also offers to stop it asking, and the diagnostics page lists the blocked sites so they can unblock one. On Windows, the scanner list shows each scanner's bitness, such as "Fujitsu fi-7160 (64-bit)", and lists a driver installed in both bitnesses twice, so users can pick its 32-bit or 64-bit version; a plain scanner name still scans, with the 64-bit version when there is one. The scanner driver's dialog no longer appears: without a custom configuration, scans use the feeder when the scanner has one (the flatbed otherwise) at 200 dpi in color, and TwainSetConfig's hideUI and xferCount are ignored. TwainSetConfig's extConfig sets the scanner's image processing capabilities on Windows (blank page discard, color filter, brightness, contrast, threshold, deskew, automatic rotation, rotation, border detection, automatic brightness and double feed detection); the browser console names the ones a scanner refuses, other capabilities are not sent, and macOS ignores them. A scan that ends with paper still in the feeder shows a notice that pages may be missing. Scans stop with an error when a scanner keeps sending pages (2000 by default, or the same page 25 times in a row) or sends no page for five minutes, and on Windows a scanner driver that fails, after a paper jam for example, no longer stays stuck until the connector restarts. DocuVieware offers the connector's installer for the user's platform and asks for an update when a newer one ships. DocuViewareManager.SetLegacyTwainConnectorMode keeps the previous connector for sites that need it. The acquisition dialog has a Details panel with the connector's state and the exact error code, and the connector installs a "Nutrient Scanning Connector diagnostics" shortcut that checks the installation and tests the scanners. Scanner names and connector messages now appear as plain text in the dialog, so a scanner name can no longer inject HTML into the page. In the Blazor component, TwainGetLocalServiceStatus now returns a TwainLocalServiceStatus. (GH#3978)
* Fixes annotation dialogs keeping earlier text: new text annotations open empty, editing shows the annotation's text. (L#DV-784)
* Fixes copied right-to-left text swapping adjacent numbers and moving percent and currency signs. (L#DV-597)
* Fixes dropdown lists in PSPDFKitLight theme dialogs opening to the left of the selected value. (GH#4105)
* Fixes Dutch browsers getting Romanian labels when the viewer detects the language automatically. (L#DV-798)
* Fixes mistranslated and English-only scan and text selection labels in most viewer languages. (L#DV-798)
* Fixes mistranslated and overly literal Hebrew button labels in the viewer dialogs. (L#DV-786)
* Fixes Office documents intermittently failing to load in IIS applications that impersonate users. (L#DV-776)
* Fixes right-to-left text such as Hebrew being reversed when copied from the viewer. (L#DV-597, L#DV-798)
* Fixes search missing Hebrew and Arabic text in Office files and showing reversed snippets in results. (L#DV-743)
* Fixes search results dropping document text that looks like HTML tags. (L#DV-798)
* Fixes text selection in right-to-left lines taking the wrong part of a number or date. (L#DV-597)
* Fixes text selection losing lines when a drag crosses right-to-left and left-to-right text. (L#DV-597)
* Fixes the copy menu interrupting the next text selection. (L#DV-597)
* Fixes the preview hint in the annotation and signature dialogs always showing in English. (L#DV-798)
* Fixes the signature text preview placing bottom-aligned text outside its box. (L#DV-798)
* Fixes the text annotation dialog so its preview and alignment buttons match how right-to-left text is drawn. (L#DV-785)
* Fixes viewers that stopped loading when several opened at once right after the application started. (GH#4108)
